name: PostureEvent
title: Posture Event
description: A posture transition in the Mira network. Every time Mira's posture changes on any surface (famile, sukari, orbura, ardum), a PostureEvent is written. This entity is the realtime feed: the dashboard subscribes to it via base44.entities.PostureEvent.subscribe() and the orb components read it to sync posture across products. It is also the audit log for posture transitions.

surface.description: Surface that emitted this posture change.

previous_posture.description: The posture before this transition. Null on the first event.

valence.description: Valence at the time of the transition. -1 settled, 1 disrupted.

reaction.description: One-shot morph pulse if this event carried a reaction. Empty string for plain transitions.

note.description: Optional human-readable context for the transition. Not PHI; operational signal only.
